name: M7.Connectivity.scalar_mem
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (H : AddSubgroup (ZMod N)) (a r : ZMod N), a ∈ H → r*a ∈ H
guidance: Every r is natural cast r.val. H.nsmul_mem ha r.val gives r*a using nsmul_eq_mul and ZMod.natCast_zmod_val. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.
